explanation: A heavy (20kg) body falling onto a light (1kg) body resting near the floor produces net energy creation in one step (24->25: ~4125J to ~4780J with controller_work=0). Likely cause is sequential impulse/positional-correction ordering: the floor contact and heavy-on-light contact are resolved separately within substeps, so the light body receives overlapping restitution impulses plus positional correction energy, amplifying its rebound to ~43 m/s instead of conserving energy.
